fields.Name: T34 - Data Explorer Browse Resources
fields.Description: Verifies that the Resources entity opens from the Data Explorer entity tree and displays a populated grid of resource records.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box) and go to Data Explorer, then its Data section. In the left-hand entity tree locate the 'Resources' entity and click it. Wait patiently if the grid is slow to load (pages can take 10-30s in this resource-constrained environment). Success is reached when a grid of multiple resource records is displayed.

judgeValidationCriteria: The 'Resources' entity is selected in the Data Explorer Data section
A row grid is shown with multiple resource records (more than one row)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
